title: fix(components): create form no longer locks fields through readonlyWhen (objectui#13436)
body:
Closes #13436
Clause-②: no

## What changed

objectql does not apply `readonlyWhen` on INSERT, but the form renderer evaluated it on a create form against the seeded defaults. So a predicate over a defaulted column (`record.status == 'pending_verify'` with `status` defaulting to `'pending_verify'`) or a `!=` over an unset column (`record.approval_status != 'returned'`) locked fields the API accepts on insert.

`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`: every `resolveFieldRuleState` call now passes `readonlyWhen: isCreateForm ? undefined : RULE`. That is the existing `isCreateForm` signal (no `previousValues`), and no second mode test is added. Each call site:

- **Render path (`renderFormField`)**: the fix itself. On create the field is locked only by static `readonly: true`.
- **`conditionallyHiddenFieldNames` / `faultedVisibleWhenFieldNames` memo** (the fault-reporting path): reads only `visible` and `faults.visibleWhen`. It would still evaluate `readonlyWhen` and `console.warn` a fault for a rule the create form no longer applies, so it is gated the same way.
- **Section-divider memo (`hiddenSectionFieldNames`)** and **stale-error effect**: read only `visible` / `required`. Gated for the same no-stray-warning reason, so all sites read one answer.
- **`readonlyFieldNames` (submit strip)**: already returns early on create (`if (!previousRecord)`). Gated anyway so all five sites read the same; this is a no-op there.

`visibleWhen` / `requiredWhen` are unchanged, and `packages/core` (`resolveFieldRuleState`) is not touched.

Docs: the `readonlyWhen` row in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` and `packages/plugin-form/README.md` now says it applies to an edit form only. Changeset: `@object-ui/components` patch.

## Tests

New `form-readonly-when-create-13436.test.tsx` covers:
- create form: both reproductions from the card stay editable
- create form: static `readonly: true` still locks
- edit form (`previousValues`): the same two predicates still lock
- create form: no readonlyWhen fault is warned; an edit form still warns it

`form-fullscreen-textarea-readonly-disabled.test.tsx`: the case "holds when `readonly` is resolved at runtime by a readonlyWhen rule" now renders an edit form.

`packages/plugin-form/src/flatFieldRules.test.tsx`:
- The case "locks a `readonlyWhen`-TRUE field" now renders ModalForm and DrawerForm in edit mode (`mode: 'edit'` with a `recordId`, so the container passes `previousValues`). The create mode it used before was incidental to the original fix.
- A create-mode case was added: the same predicate leaves the field editable.

`e2e/live/field-conditional-rules.spec.ts`: on the New dialog, the Paid step now asserts that `tax_rate` stays editable, because the server exempts INSERT from `readonlyWhen`. **This spec was not run here.** It is a live spec and is not in the `test:e2e:live:ci` allowlist.

Results at 5a57d8eb52 (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`):
- The three form rule test files: 26/26 passed.
- The whole form renderer directory with the downstream readonlyWhen suites (app-shell, fields, kanban, console): green except the 2 `flatFieldRules` cases that pinned create-mode locking. Those are now amended as above.
- `packages/plugin-form/`: 199/199 files, 2379 passed, 1 skipped.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/components...`: 17/17 passed.
- eslint on the five touched source and test files: 0 errors.
- `check-changeset-presence` and `check:new-line-citations` both exit 0, with 0 new citations.

Ablation (fix committed, then reverted in the working tree, and the restore proved by the HEAD blob hash):
- Reverting all five gates in form.tsx turns the 3 create-form cases in the new file red, and the edit and static cases stay green.
- The same revert turns the new `flatFieldRules` create case red for ModalForm and DrawerForm.
- Reverting only the visibility-memo gate turns only the fault case red.
- The edit-mode lock case is not vacuous: with a FALSE predicate it goes red.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## Not in this PR

- **A `mode: 'view'` ObjectForm.** It also gets no `previousValues`, so form.tsx reads it as create (the existing comment on the server-default hint already says so). A `readonlyWhen`-TRUE field there now renders as a disabled input instead of a read-only display. Every field in view mode is disabled already, so nothing becomes editable.
- **`WizardForm`'s final-submit gate** (`gateFinalSubmit`, plugin-form). It still passes `readonlyWhen` on a create wizard. It reads only `required` and `faults.visibleWhen`, so it locks nothing, but it can still warn a `readonlyWhen` fault on create.
